parsed.rationale: Three distinct types — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — all in the `Wallpaper` package each carry an exact-duplicate `blendMode` computed property at line 62 of their respective files. Because the query is `function-duplicates-exact` and all three implementations are identical, the body can be expressed once as a default implementation on a new `BlendModeConvertible` protocol (or an existing one if it already exists in the package). All three conforming types would then delete their local implementations, eliminating the triplication while preserving the per-type identity. A new file `BlendModeConvertible.swift` in the same `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/` directory is the natural home, keeping the change entirely within the `Wallpaper` package.
